chunks: And Abu Ja'far al-Baqir عليه السلام said:
"The ghusl of the deceased is like the ghusl of the person in janabah. If he has abundant hair, then pour the water over it three times."

key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in a state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ: three times; the specified number of repetitions
key_terms.غُسْلُ: ritual washing; here, the prescribed washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: How should the ghusl of the deceased be performed according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the ghusl of the deceased, stating that it is performed like the ghusl of a person in janabah. It also specifies that if the deceased has abundant hair, water should be poured over it three times to ensure proper washing.
